subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Smart Speakers Are Listening
description: One-minute skill: Smart Speakers Are Listening.

hook.text: Alexa is always listening. She has to be — she's waiting for you to say her name.

buildup.text: Smart speakers process audio locally until a wake word triggers cloud recording and analysis.

discovery.text: Amazon, Google, and Apple all employed humans to listen to recordings for 'quality improvement.'

twist.text: Workers heard private conversations, medical discussions, and even sounds of distress.

climax.text: A device you invited into your home became a microphone that strangers could listen through.

punchline.text: Always listening. Not always just a machine.

quiz.question: What did companies do with smart speaker recordings?
options: Employed humans to listen to them for quality improvement
Only stored them with explicit user consent
